description: This is a PHP source file implementing the 'ShippingAddress' controller class for the checkout process in an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It handles displaying and saving shipping address details, including validation and session management.

classes.name: ShippingAddress
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping address in the checkout process, including methods for displaying and saving shipping address data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the shipping address form with existing data and custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the submitted shipping address data, updating the session and database.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Loads a specific existing address into the session based on address_id parameter.
